opinions.note: The European Council announced at 23:50 Brussels time on 26 November that it had put forward Pablo Hernández de Cos to succeed Christine Lagarde as ECB President, before the 23:59 deadline.
JMIC Update 117 lists no qualifying incident on November 24 Gulf time; the three Hormuz tanker strikes reported that day occurred before the window.

An official European Council press release published on consilium.europa.eu at 23:50 on 26 November 2026 confirms that the European Council put forward Pablo Hernández de Cos as the next President of the European Central Bank to succeed Christine Lagarde.
António Costa said 24 member states backed the proposed €45 billion loan, but leaders would return to it in December, so no agreement was reached by the November 26 deadline.

The Court’s calendar scheduled the pronouncement for November 24, 2026, but no qualifying source confirms it occurred that day, and Český rozhlas’s counsel reports the annulment while dating the judgment November 24, 2025.
The Ukrainian Air Force’s first overnight summary reported that Russia launched 113 attack UAVs, including decoys, in the night of 25–26 November 2026, with missiles counted separately.

JMIC Advisory Update 117 and UKMTO's incident records covering 22–26 November 2026 (UKMTO 217-26 through 223-26) show that all reported attacks and incidents during this period occurred on 22 November (including time-late reports 219-26, 220-26, and 221-26 issued on 24 November) or 25 November (222-26 and 223-26), with no qualifying incident taking place on 24 November 2026.

Following the Special European Council on 26 November 2026, President António Costa stated that while 24 member states supported the Commission's proposal for an additional loan to Ukraine, no agreement was reached and leaders will revert to the question in December.
UKMTO Warning 222-26 reports a projectile explosion near a tanker 50 nautical miles west of Dubai at 21:30 UTC on November 25, 2026, which was 01:30 Gulf Standard Time on November 26.

According to the Ukrainian Air Force's summary of the overnight attack published on 26 November 2026 (covering from 18:00 on 25 November), Russia launched 113 attack drones (including 76 jet-powered Shahed-type UAVs, Gerbera, and Parodiya decoys) at Ukraine.
On November 26, 2026, the Bank of Korea announced that its Monetary Policy Board raised the Base Rate by 25 basis points, from 3.00% to 3.25%.
The Bank of Korea announced a 25-basis-point increase from 3.00% to 3.25% and said that Hwang Kunil and Lee Soohyung dissented in favor of holding the rate at 3.00%.
The Bank of Korea announced in its Monetary Policy Decision on November 26, 2026, that the Monetary Policy Board decided to raise the Base Rate by 25 basis points from 3.00% to 3.25%.

NIM’s November 26 press release reported Germany’s headline consumer climate forecast for December 2026 at −30.2 points. ([nim.org](https://www.nim.org/en/press/article/konsumklima-wenig-rueckenwind-fuer-das-weihnachtsgeschaeft-1))
The NIM/GfK consumer climate indicator for Germany for December 2026, published on Thursday 26 November 2026, stands at -30.2 points.
Barlovento Comunicación reported a combined average audience of 10.190 million viewers across the 22 channels that carried the November 26 debate, using data from Fifty5Blue, formerly Kantar Media.

Barlovento Comunicación reported that the four-way election debate on 26 November 2026 registered a combined average audience (audiencia media) of 10.19 million (10,190,000 viewers, rounded to 10.2 million in the summary text) and a 70.5% share across the 22 channels that carried it.

On 26 November 2026, the Bank of Korea announced that its Monetary Policy Board decided to raise the Base Rate by 25 basis points from 3.00% to 3.25%, with two board members (Hwang Kunil and Lee Soohyung) dissenting in favour of maintaining the rate at 3.00%.
The Senate’s official record, filed on 26 November 2026, confirms that the joint committee met that day and concluded it could not agree on a common text for the 2027 PLFSS.

The French Senate legislative dossier and Public Sénat confirm that the commission mixte paritaire on the PLFSS 2027 met on Thursday 26 November 2026 and concluded that morning that it could not agree on a common text (non conclusive).

UKMTO Warning 222-26 reports that the master of a tanker 50 nautical miles west of Dubai in the Persian Gulf reported an explosion caused by an unknown projectile in close proximity to the vessel at 21:30 UTC on 25 November 2026, which is 01:30 Gulf Standard Time (UTC+4) on Thursday 26 November 2026.

Colt CZ Group published its 9M 2026 results on November 26 and confirmed full-year guidance of CZK 31–33 billion in revenue and CZK 8–8.5 billion in adjusted EBITDA, leaving both lower bounds unchanged.

The Constitutional Court pronounced judgment III. ÚS 2839/25 on 24 November 2026, granting Český rozhlas's constitutional complaint and annulling Supreme Administrative Court judgment 5 Afs 151/2024-56 of 31 July 2025.
BBC News reported that RMT London Underground drivers began their 24-hour walkout at noon GMT on Thursday, 26 November 2026.
The Electoral Commission declared the official results on 27 November 2026 NZ time, giving National (40), ACT (13), and NZ First (12) exactly half of the 130 seats, including overhang.
The Bundestag’s official roll-call page records that the Haushaltsgesetz 2027 passed its final third-reading vote on 27 November 2026 with 316 yes votes, 260 no votes, and no abstentions.
Reuters reported that Rheinmetall’s November 27 Capital Markets Day slides set a 2030 group sales target of €33–37 billion, with a midpoint of €35 billion, below the €50 billion threshold.

The official results declared by the Electoral Commission on 27 November 2026 allocate National 40 seats, ACT 13 seats, and New Zealand First 12 seats, giving them a combined total of 65 out of 130 seats (exactly half) in the House of Representatives.

In its 9M 2026 financial results release published on 26 November 2026, Colt CZ Group SE explicitly confirmed its current full-year 2026 guidance of CZK 31.0–33.0 billion in revenue and CZK 8.0–8.5 billion in adjusted EBITDA.

According to the official Bundestag roll-call voting results for 27 November 2026, the Haushaltsgesetz 2027 (Drucksachen 21/7300, 21/7302) passed its final third-reading vote with 316 yes votes and 260 no votes.
INSEE’s provisional release reports that France’s all-households consumer price index (IPC) rose 2.9% year on year in November 2026.
INE’s flash estimate puts Spain’s overall CPI inflation for November 2026 at 4.1% year on year.
INSEE's provisional Informations rapides for November 2026 (No. 295) reports that the year-on-year change in the consumer price index (IPC, ensemble des ménages) is 2.9% (+2,9 %).
TN.cz reported that Václav Noid Bárta won the Zlatý slavík in the Zpěvák category at the November 27, 2026 gala.

According to a Reuters report on 27 November 2026, Rheinmetall published presentation slides for its Capital Markets Day cutting its 2030 sales target to between €33 billion and €37 billion (a midpoint of €35 billion, which is below €50 billion).
INE's flash estimate (indicador adelantado) for November 2026 published on 27 November 2026 puts the annual rate of the general CPI (IPC general) at 4.1%.

Czech national outlet Novinky.cz (as well as ČTK reports) confirms that Václav Noid Bárta won first place in the Zpěvák category at the Český slavík 2026 gala in Prague's Forum Karlín on 27 November 2026.
The Evening Standard reports that RMT London Underground drivers launched their 24-hour strike and walked out at 12 noon on Thursday 26 November 2026.
